d:
13 sal ke lanbe intzar ke bad GTA 6 riliz ho gaya hai. gem ke trelar ne rikord banae aur iski divangi duniyabhar men dekhne ko mil rahi hai. bharat men piem narendr modi ne bhi iska zikr kiya hai. janie GTA 6 men kya hai khas, gem ki kimat kitni hai aur iski shuruaat kahan se huee thi.
Aavaz: priyanka jha
Vidiyo editar: aamra aamir
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
(kripya not karen: naya aip briten aur amerika men uplabdh nahin hai.)
